data.narrative:
Tritone Technologies is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company founded by Ofer Ben-Zur. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies: Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B), supplemented by a broader universe including 5 additional private robotics firms and 1 public comparable.

The peer-median method, the applicable triangulation approach given available data, yields a median valuation of $1.8B across the three primary comps. The peer range spans $1.6B to $2.0B, reflecting meaningful dispersion within the robotics and manufacturing cohort at Series B. This method carries weight given the homogeneity of stage and sector, though reliance on a limited sample of three companies constrains statistical confidence.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.5B to $2.0B, with a median of $1.8B. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-company sample, potential idiosyncratic differences in Tritone's business model relative to peers, and the degree to which public-market robotics valuations (represented by one ticker, 277810.KQ) would calibrate this private-market range if applied. Additional fundraising data or revenue multiples would strengthen conviction in this range.
